relationships.subject: tramadol
relationships.evidence_quote: Tramadol intake increased renal TLR-4 followed by significant increase in renal NF-κB compared with the control group.

relationships.subject: tramadol
relationships.evidence_quote: tramadol administration significantly decreased the antioxidant effect of renal HO-1 and reduced glutathione (GSH) and superoxide dismutase (SOD)

relationships.subject: 10-dehydrogingerdione
relationships.evidence_quote: 10-DHGD administered either individually or combined with tramadol greatly decreased levels of TLR4 by 89.8% and 85.9%, respectively, compared with the tramadol group.

relationships.subject: 10-dehydrogingerdione
relationships.evidence_quote: Individual or combined administration of 10-DHGD significantly decreased ERK1 level by 55.4% & 43.5%, respectively, compared with tramadol alone

relationships.subject: 10-dehydrogingerdione
relationships.evidence_quote: 10-DHGD administration ameliorated such increase compared with the tramadol group and 10-DHGD +tramadol

key_findings: Tramadol increased renal TLR4, NF-kB, ERK1 and caspase-3 and lowered HO-1, GSH and SOD in rats.
10-DHGD counteracted these changes and the histological damage.
